Some new users here seem to be confused as to what this subverse stands for. This post aims to explain:

Simply put, "HDL" stands for "Hiddenlol". If this is all you wanted to know, then I'm glad I could explain it to you.

But what is Hiddenlol? Or rather, what was Hiddenlol?

To answer this, we need to go back in time, all the way to 9gag. Yes, 9gag. The normie-infested, possibly-worse-than-Facebook bottom-of-the-barrel 9gag. You see, we didn't one day go online and thought to ourselves "You know what? I think I'm going to become far-right today!" and that was that. Our motives were simpler, we just wanted to be entertained.

9gag was on the rise back then, when rage comics were considered to be "fresh" (dank wasn't a thing back then). We all looked at silly memes, shared them and generally had a good time. Of course, the quality of 9gag declined quickly. People began reposting ungodly amounts, and anyone with any sense of taste fled to the fresh section. Yes, most of it was trash, but the occassional original content was worth it.

9gag didn't care too much. They loved how much content was posted, because all of it gave them ad revenue. But what they failed to realize was that it was this overload of garbage that drove their core userbase away.

Sooner or later, some people got suck of it and wanted the old 9gag back, but they realized that 9gag was beyond salvation. Posts of alternative sites started popping up on Fresh, and mods were quick to delete them, but of course, some users saw. People started talking, and one name that fell more and more was "Hugelol".

Hugelol was to many what 9gag should always have been. A place to share memes, and nothing more. I remember how fascinating I found it browsing through early Hugelol and every single post was high-quality OC. The humor was quite dark and "politically incorrect", but still on an acceptable level. Less "When you kill niggs lmao" and more "Black humor is like a kid with cancer - it never gets old".

Of course, some jokes had nazi content, but it was more because nazis are considered evil by mainstream perception, thus the perfect fit for dark humor.

Then, the advertisers protested. Not much "official" information was given out, as the administrators refused to communicate openly, so most of this info is a "best guess". Apparently, advertisers didn't like that their new SUV was on the same page next to a joke about nazis, so they threatened to pull their ads. The admins cracked down on "dark humor" and deleted everything slightly offensive.

Hugelol's posters begged for a way to keep the site as it is, with suggestions like donations, "Premium" accounts, etc.

While premium accounts were introduced for a while, something much more drastic happened. Hiddenlol happened.

The admins made a sister-site to hugelol, called hiddenlol. The ads were as degenerate as you would expect, and the rules were never communicated clearly. Users interpreted this as "Anything goes". And so, Hiddenlol was free to be whatever the community wanted it to be.

Very quickly, dark humor turned very very dark and "good taste" was left outside. From there on, Hiddenlol developed itself. Some people quickly started posting content that idealized the nazis, while others posted porn or gore.

Some considered Hiddenlol to be a "nazi forum", but it was never intended to be one. People posted memes, and as time progressed, some started taking the ideology more serious. There was still a divide in the community however, if HDL was serious or not. I personally always downvoted posts like "Holocaust is fake history! Google <whatever>" - not because I was a kike shill, but because those posts just had no humor attached to them at all. Others liked these posts and downvoted gore or such, as it opposed their pure National Socialist movement.

All in all, it wasn't that bad. The people got along, I made some OC memes, but mostly stuck to commenting and debating with people. Then, early march, the New Zealand shooting happened. I assume the admins got scared that somebody would upload the manifesto to Hiddenlol, and that someone would start investigating them, so they blocked everyone from posting. Comments were still enabled, and so were direct messages.

Initially, Hiddenlol migrated to Reddit, just to have a temporary home until things got sorted out. Several people tried to contact the admins, but they refused to communicate in any way. Soon after, Reddit closed us down. Allegedly, for posting content that glorified violence, even though no such thing ever happened.

Soon after, we migrated to Voat, and this is where we are now. Many original Hiddenlol userssimply stopped posting, or went their own way. Some went back to Hugelol, others came here.

I don't know what the future will bring. Will we stay here? Will we find a new home? I don't know, but I miss the community, I miss the shitposting. I wish things were how they were.
